parameters.query:
/* ================================================================
   Validación Monitoreo Fragmentación – OpsObservability (sin GO)
   Incluye:
     1) Smoke test tabla y últimas filas
     2) Top por fragmentación (últimos 30 min)
     3) Resumen por ejecución (run_id) reciente
     4) Conteo ALERTA vs OK (últimas 24h)
     5) Verificación de inserts en monitoring_top_entities (último run)
   ================================================================ */

USE OpsObservability;
SET NOCOUNT ON;

/* 0) Existencia de tablas requeridas */
PRINT '>>> 0) Verificando tablas requeridas...';
IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.monitoring_index_fragmentation','U') IS NULL
BEGIN
  RAISERROR('La tabla dbo.monitoring_index_fragmentation NO existe. Ejecuta el flujo para que la cree.', 10, 1) WITH NOWAIT;
END
ELSE
BEGIN
  PRINT 'OK: Existe dbo.monitoring_index_fragmentation';
END

IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.monitoring_instance','U') IS NULL
BEGIN
  RAISERROR('La tabla dbo.monitoring_instance NO existe.', 10, 1) WITH NOWAIT;
END
ELSE
BEGIN
  PRINT 'OK: Existe dbo.monitoring_instance';
END

IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.monitoring_top_entities','U') IS NULL
BEGIN
  RAISERROR('La tabla dbo.monitoring_top_entities NO existe (se usa para TOPs).', 10, 1) WITH NOWAIT;
END
ELSE
BEGIN
  PRINT 'OK: Existe dbo.monitoring_top_entities';
END
PRINT '---';

/* 1) Smoke test: últimas filas crudas */
PRINT '>>> 1) Últimos 50 registros crudos (monitoring_index_fragmentation)';
SELECT TOP (50)
  ts_utc, instance_id, base_datos, esquema, tabla, nombre_indice,
  fragmentacion_pct, paginas, estado, run_id
FROM dbo.monitoring_index_fragmentation WITH (NOLOCK)
ORDER BY ts_utc DESC;
PRINT '---';

/* 2) Top por fragmentación en los últimos 30 min */
PRINT '>>> 2) Top 10 por fragmentación promedio (últimos 30 min)';
SELECT TOP (10)
  i.instance_name,
  d.base_datos, d.esquema, d.tabla, d.nombre_indice,
  AVG(d.fragmentacion_pct) AS frag_prom,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.estado='ALERTA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS filas_alerta,
  MAX(d.ts_utc) AS ts_utc_ult
FROM dbo.monitoring_index_fragmentation d WITH (NOLOCK)
JOIN dbo.monitoring_instance i WITH (NOLOCK)
  ON i.instance_id = d.instance_id
WHERE d.ts_utc >= DATEADD(MINUTE,-30,SYSUTCDATETIME())
GROUP BY i.instance_name, d.base_datos, d.esquema, d.tabla, d.nombre_indice
ORDER BY frag_prom DESC;
PRINT '---';

/* 3) Resumen por ejecución (run_id) reciente */
PRINT '>>> 3) Resumen por run_id (20 últimos lotes)';
WITH last_runs AS (
  SELECT TOP (20) run_id, MAX(ts_utc) ts_ult
  FROM dbo.monitoring_index_fragmentation WITH (NOLOCK)
  GROUP BY run_id
  ORDER BY ts_ult DESC
)
SELECT
  r.ts_ult,
  m.instance_name,
  d.run_id,
  COUNT(*)                         AS filas_total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.estado='ALERTA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS filas_alerta,
  AVG(d.fragmentacion_pct)         AS frag_prom,
  MAX(d.fragmentacion_pct)         AS frag_max
FROM last_runs r
JOIN dbo.monitoring_index_fragmentation d WITH (NOLOCK) ON d.run_id = r.run_id
JOIN dbo.monitoring_instance m WITH (NOLOCK) ON m.instance_id = d.instance_id
GROUP BY r.ts_ult, m.instance_name, d.run_id
ORDER BY r.ts_ult DESC;
PRINT '---';

/* 4) Conteo ALERTA vs OK (últimas 24h) */
PRINT '>>> 4) Conteo ALERTA vs OK (últimas 24h)';
SELECT
  m.instance_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.estado='ALERTA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alertas,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.estado<>'ALERTA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS oks,
  MIN(d.ts_utc) AS desde_utc,
  MAX(d.ts_utc) AS hasta_utc
FROM dbo.monitoring_index_fragmentation d WITH (NOLOCK)
JOIN dbo.monitoring_instance m WITH (NOLOCK) ON m.instance_id = d.instance_id
WHERE d.ts_utc >= DATEADD(DAY,-1,SYSUTCDATETIME())
GROUP BY m.instance_name
ORDER BY alertas DESC;
PRINT '---';

/* 5) Verificación de monitoring_top_entities del último run */
PRINT '>>> 5) Verificación de TOPs (último run en monitoring_index_fragmentation)';
WITH last_run AS (
  SELECT TOP (1) run_id, MAX(ts_utc) ts_ult
  FROM dbo.monitoring_index_fragmentation WITH (NOLOCK)
  GROUP BY run_id
  ORDER BY ts_ult DESC
)
SELECT
  t.ts_utc,
  i.instance_name,
  t.scope_type,
  t.scope_key,           -- esperado: db|schema|table|index
  t.metric_name,         -- 'fragmentacion_pct' o 'no_data'
  t.metric_value,
  t.rank_n,
  t.run_id
FROM dbo.monitoring_top_entities t WITH (NOLOCK)
JOIN last_run r ON r.run_id = t.run_id
LEFT JOIN dbo.monitoring_instance i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.instance_id = t.instance_id
WHERE t.scope_type = 'index_frag'
ORDER BY t.rank_n ASC, t.metric_value DESC;
PRINT '---';

DECLARE @inst sysname = N'{{$node["Set - Params"].json["instance_name"]}}';

SELECT mi.instance_id,
       s.base_datos,
       s.esquema,
       s.tabla,
       s.nombre_indice,
       s.last_state,
       s.last_change_utc
FROM OpsObservability.dbo.monitoring_instance mi WITH (NOLOCK)
LEFT JOIN OpsObservability.dbo.monitoring_index_fragmentation_state s WITH (NOLOCK)
  ON s.instance_id = mi.instance_id
WHERE mi.instance_name = @inst;
